newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer, gas oil up $2/tonne.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer, gas oil up $2/tonne.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Wednesday, with gas oil outright prices rising $2 a tonne.
Naphtha rose by $1 on swaps in response to higher crude futures, while a high paraffinic high quality Braefoot Bay cargo was seen done at $192 CIF NWE amid indicated pipeline spec bids at $190.
Gasoline was $2 higher on the balance-of-July barge market for Eurograde, which was seen done at $196 and $196.50 before the latter became the bid level.
A tight physical market and higher values on NYMEX and IPE screens pushed up gasoline August swaps by $.50 to $193.50-$194.
NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady to firmer. Two cargoes were heard sold at $107 fob Ireland and fob Scandinvaia.
Gas oil rose $2 a tonne, with August IPE futures settling at $164.75. Heating oil differentials were pressured but those for low sulphur diesel were steady.
